snippet.title: Second Stone: The Legend of the Hidden World - Official Game Overview Trailer
snippet.description:
Second Stone is a story-driven adventure game fusing fast-paced Action-RPG combat with platforming. Jump between two worlds as Shiren, a young treasure hunter from Arimaya Village in search of the secret behind the dark hidden world. Experience an epic hero's journey with a slice of nostalgia and super fun gameplay!

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3557360/Second_Stone_The_Legend_of_the_Hidden_World/

Developer: Skyward Entertainment
X: https://x.com/SecondStoneGame

#indiegame #action #adventure
